text:
olga: Quick thread from today's design review. New constraints: we want stable, human-readable permalinks (no raw DB IDs), an optional shortlink service for sharing in Slack/email, and graceful degradation for users without access. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder-permalinks :mag:
peter: good list. Can you sketch the canonical path shape you want? also worried about exposing internal slugs for sensitive projects. :lock:
olga: proposal for canonical paths using slugs: /orgs/:orgSlug/projects/:projSlug/models/:modelSlug[/deployments/:depSlug[/runs/:runSlug]]
- keep canonical paths pasteable and canonical (no query tokens for core resources)
- shortlink service: rwd.link/<token> that redirects to canonical
- shortlinks are optional and rate-limited, useful for Slack/messages
sam: UX/engineering notes:
- shortlink creation should be explicit (copy permalink -> show "Shorten for sharing" toggle)
- shortlinks should be revocable and audited (privacy/compliance)
- legacy numeric IDs will 301 -> slug paths for 12 months
mira: accessibility/copy behavior:
- copy button must be keyboard-focusable, with aria-live polite announcing "Copied permalink" and the full canonical path in an offscreen element for SRs
- shortlink copy should also announce "Shortlink copied" and expose original canonical path in aria-hidden element for screen readers that need full context
- when opening a shortlink and user lacks permission, land on a helpful access request modal instead of 403 plain page
links-bot: policy note: shortlinks should not leak internal-only identifiers; token must be random and map to a server-side record with ACL checks at redirect time
peter: how do we handle canonical vs ephemeral state? example: metrics tab open or logs drawer open. prefer path-based canonical for shareable state (/metrics) and hash/query for ephemeral UI like temporarily-open filters
olga: agreed. canonical path includes the active top-level tab only (e.g., /models/:id/metrics). ephemeral panel states use hash (#logs=open) so they don't create brittle external links
sam: infra ops: redirects and mapping plan:
- server 301 from legacy numeric paths to slug canonical for 12 months
- client-side mapping and feature-flagged fallback for another 12 months
- shortlink service with TTL and revocation endpoint
infra: will create tickets for redirects and shortlink service. telemetry dashboard to track legacy hits and shortlink usage
mira: a11y nit: when a deep link opens a subpage, focus MUST move to H1 and breadcrumb should have aria-current. collapsed breadcrumb ellipsis must announce full path via aria-label and be keyboard-expandable
olga: copy UX nit: provide both "Copy canonical permalink" and "Copy shortlink" buttons in the copy modal. default to canonical for reproducibility, shortlink optional
peter: e2e checklist:
- open direct canonical URL /orgs/x/projects/y/models/slug/metrics -> assert metrics tab active, H1 focused, breadcrumb aria-current
- open rwd.link/<token> as a non-member -> assert redirect to access-request modal with clear CTA
- copy actions: keyboard-only nav to copy button, assert aria-live announces success and SR-visible full path
links-bot: automation: create a job to rotate shortlink tokens older than 2 years and surface revoked-link telemetry to security
mira: screenreader test: copy flow must expose the canonical path in an offscreen region so users can discover the full path even if they used the shortlink
olga: timeline: I'll update Figma with slug examples and the copy modal, open RFC for routing helpers (/src/routes/paths.ts) with slugify rules + legacy mapping table, and draft the shortlink API contract. Quick sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to walk infra through ACLs. :calendar:
peter: i'll add the redirect list to the PR and coordinate docs with product. thanks all. :thumbsup:
